description: Set a provider workspace's daily spend limit (cents, UTC day) and calls per minute; 0 = no cap at that level (the platform ceiling still applies). Site admins with an admin-scoped token only. Safe to retry: the same numbers again change nothing. Audit-logged. Mirrors PUT /api/v2/admin/ai-workspaces/:workspace/quota. Returns {workspace, dailyCents, rpm, effect: updated|unchanged}.

daily_cents.description: Daily spend limit in cents (UTC day). 0 = no cap at this level; the platform ceiling still applies.

rpm.description: Calls admitted per sliding minute. 0 = no rate limit at this level.

name: gluecron_set_ai_workspace_quota
